		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]RequestAccepted"],0)
		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]RequestAutoAccepted"],0)
		#disable timer

if previousValue.value==0 and currentValue.value ==1:

		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]RequestAccepted"],0)

		#disable timer

		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]ProfilesAreRetrievingA","[.]ProfileCompleteA","[.]ProfileFailedA", "[.]ProfilesAreRetrievingB","[.]ProfileCompleteB","[.]ProfileFailedB"], [0]*6)		
	if previousValue.value == 0 and currentValue.value == 1:
		selectedSEM = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]Status/ChannelASelected","[.]Status/ChannelBSelected"])
		if  selectedSEM[0].value: # SEM A is selected
			system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]ProfilesAreRetrievingA"], [1])	
		if  selectedSEM[1].value: # SEM B is selected
			system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]ProfilesAreRetrievingB"], [1])	
			
		# GET CONFIGURATION	
		locationInfo = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]Area","[.]Structure"])
		area = locationInfo[0].value
		structure = locationInfo[1].value
		ValveName = tag['parameters']['ValveName']
		
		# updated in 0.0.1.0 - read Octa 3 in the tag 
		ProfileIPAddressOcta3 = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]ProfileIPAddressOcta3A","[.]ProfileIPAddressOcta3B"],500)
		
		# read IP Address of the Card contains Actual Pressure
		IPAddressActPressA = tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta1and2'] + "." + str(ProfileIPAddressOcta3[0].value) + "." + tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta4ActPress'] 
		IPAddressActPressB = tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta1and2'] + "." + str(ProfileIPAddressOcta3[1].value) + "." + tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta4ActPress'] 
		# read IP Address of the Card contains Supply/Rtn FLow
		IPAddressFlowA = tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta1and2'] + "." + str(ProfileIPAddressOcta3[0].value) + "." + tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta4Flow'] 
		IPAddressFlowB = tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta1and2'] + "." + str(ProfileIPAddressOcta3[1].value) + "." + tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta4Flow'] 
		
		# read IP Address of the Card contains Supply/Rtn Pressure
		IPAddressSupPressA = tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta1and2'] + "." + str(ProfileIPAddressOcta3[0].value) + "." + tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta4SupPress'] 
		IPAddressSupPressB = tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta1and2'] + "." + str(ProfileIPAddressOcta3[1].value) + "." + tag['parameters']['ProfileIPAddressOcta4SupPress'] 
		#updated 0.0.1.0 - end
		# Create the tagtaglist of IP Address
		IPAddressListA = [IPAddressActPressA,IPAddressFlowA,IPAddressSupPressA]
		IPAddressListB = [IPAddressActPressB,IPAddressFlowB,IPAddressSupPressB]
		# read channel numbers
		ChannelActPress = tag['parameters']['ProfileChannelActualPressure']
		
		lastOperation=system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]LastCommand"],1000)[0].value # check the last operation to determint the supply or return 
		ChannelSupRtnFlow= ""
		ChannelSupRtnPress=""
		operationType = ""
		pressureTagPathList = []
		pulsePerLitre = 0
		
		processFolderTagPath = ('/').join(tagPath.split('/')[:-2])+"/" # for pressure tagpath retrieve
		
		

		if lastOperation == 1: #open
			operationType = "OPEN"
			ChannelSupRtnFlow = tag['parameters']['ProfileChannelFlowSupply']
			ChannelSupRtnPress = tag['parameters']['ProfileChannelPressureSupply']
			#update 0.0.1.3 - BEGIN
			pressureTagPathList = [processFolderTagPath + tag['parameters']['ActuatorName'], processFolderTagPath + tag['parameters']['SupplyPressureName']]
			pulsePerLitre = tag['parameters']['ProfilePulsePerLitreSupply']
			
			#update 0.0.1.3 - END
			
		else: #close
			operationType = "CLOSE"
			ChannelSupRtnFlow = tag['parameters']['ProfileChannelFlowReturn']
			ChannelSupRtnPress = tag['parameters']['ProfileChannelPressureReturn']
			#update 0.0.1.5 - BEGIN
			pressureTagPathList = [processFolderTagPath + tag['parameters']['ActuatorName'], processFolderTagPath + tag['parameters']['ReturnPressureName']]
			#update 0.0.1.5 - END
			pulsePerLitre = tag['parameters']['ProfilePulsePerLitreReturn']
			
			
			
		# Create the list of channel number
		ChannelList = [ChannelActPress,ChannelSupRtnFlow,ChannelSupRtnPress]
		#Check if the profiles are enabled / disabled
		profileDisableReadTag = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]ActuatorPressureProfileDisable","[.]FlowProfileDisable","[.]PressureProfileDisable"])
		profileEnableList = [not profileDisableReadTag[0].value,not profileDisableReadTag[1].value,not profileDisableReadTag[2].value]
		#Read the eventNumber
		eventNumber = int(system.tag.readBlocking("[.]EventNumber")[0].value)
		str_eventNumber = "{:0{}d}".format(eventNumber, 3) #convert to fixed 3 digit string
		#read eng unit
		engUnitPress = tag['parameters']['EngUnitPressure']
		engUnitFlow = tag['parameters']['EngUnitFlowrate']
		#handling the profiles
		profileResultA = []
		profileResultB = []
			
		
		if  selectedSEM[0].value: # SEM A is selected	
			profileResultA = BHValveProfile.ProfileHandler(area, structure, ValveName,operationType, 0, IPAddressListA, ChannelList, str_eventNumber, profileEnableList,pressureTagPathList,pulsePerLitre,engUnitFlow)
			if profileResultA[0] == 1: # successfull
				system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]ProfilePathA","[.]ProfileCompleteA","[.]ProfileFailedA","[.]ProfilesAreRetrievingA"], [profileResultA[1],1,0,0])
			else: # failed
				system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]ProfilePathA","[.]ProfileCompleteA","[.]ProfileFailedA","[.]ProfilesAreRetrievingA"], ["",0,1,0])
		
		if  selectedSEM[1].value: # SEM B is selected
			profileResultB = BHValveProfile.ProfileHandler(area, structure, ValveName,operationType, 1, IPAddressListB, ChannelList, str_eventNumber, profileEnableList,pressureTagPathList,pulsePerLitre,engUnitFlow)
			if profileResultB[0] == 1: # successfull
				system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]ProfilePathB","[.]ProfileCompleteB","[.]ProfileFailedB","[.]ProfilesAreRetrievingB"], [profileResultB[1],1,0,0])
			else: # failed
				system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]ProfilePathB","[.]ProfileCompleteB","[.]ProfileFailedB","[.]ProfilesAreRetrievingB"], ["",0,1,0])
